The possible divisor pairs of \(500\) with \(10 \le t \le 35\) and \(25 \le s \le 35\) are found from:

- \(t=10 \Rightarrow s=50\) (not allowed)
- \(t=20 \Rightarrow s=25\) (allowed)
- \(t=25 \Rightarrow s=20\) (not allowed)

So the only possible formation is \(s=25,\ t=20\).

Using the corrected ratio condition:
\[
\frac{s}{t} \ge \frac15 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad t \le 5s
\]
For \(s=25,\ t=20\):
\[
20 \le 5(25)=125
\]
which is true.

Thus there is exactly \(1\) possible formation.

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
